data.title: NASDAQ Composite Index (FRED)
data.summary: The NASDAQ Composite fell 36.4% from its record close of 16,057.44 on 19 November 2021 to its cycle low close of 10,213.29 on 28 December 2022.
data.citation: NASDAQ OMX Group, NASDAQ Composite Index [NASDAQCOM], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, 27 August 2026.
